pattern.description: Continuation of the closing mascot beat: inside the static circle, the Notion AI face shifts from a squinting wink pose to a neutral, two-eyed pose with both brows arched, drawn as a handful of stepped poses before it holds.
pattern.why_premium: Animating only the facial strokes, on twos, while the circle stays locked gives the brand mark a deliberate, hand-animated character moment to end on, without any camera or layout noise.

build_hint.gsap: Swap pose layers or morph stroke paths with a stepped tween: tl.to('.face', {morphSVG: '#pose-neutral', duration: 0.25, ease: 'steps(3)'}) or tl.set('.pose-n', {autoAlpha: 1}) every 2 frames; keep the circle static.
build_hint.remotion: Choose the face pose by Math.min(Math.floor(frame / 2), poses.length - 1) over ~6-8 frames (animating on twos) and hold the last pose; the circle outline stays a constant element.

notes: Energy alternates spike/zero every other frame, consistent with stepped (on-twos) pose changes rather than a smooth tween. Follows e029 in the same shot (e030 not in this batch). No SFX candidates.
